title: Add organization policy overlay preview
purpose: Design how organization policy overlays would be previewed without weakening local safety invariants.
scope: Define overlay states: absent, compatible, stricter, incompatible, unsigned and revoked.
Define policy diff UX for added restrictions and attempted broadening.
Require local safety invariants to remain non-removable.
Define activation preview and approval requirements for overlays.
acceptance_criteria: Overlay preview cannot disable exact approval or no-shell invariants.
Policy broadening requires explicit approval and runtime mediation.
Unsigned or revoked overlays are visibly blocked.
Preview remains design/projection until implementation task is approved.
failure_modes: Overlay design allows weakening local core policy.
